choice.title: Sky Recomp (Skyward Sword HD)
choice.description: Native port of The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword HD. Needs macOS 15 or later. On first launch, point it at your own uncompressed v1.0.0 game files (romfs and exefs).

choice.title: Mush8 (Mario Kart 8 Deluxe)
choice.description: Native port of Mario Kart 8 Deluxe with LAN, online and wireless multiplayer. Needs macOS 14 or later. On first launch, point it at a folder with your prod.keys, base game and update 4.0.1 .nsp files and a Firmware folder.

choice.title: Build Tears of the Kingdom
choice.description: A helper that builds The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom into /Applications from your own .xci/.nsp and prod.keys using MacNativeGames. The game itself cannot be shipped. Needs macOS 26 or later, Homebrew and about 25 to 40 GB free.
